system: userData tag contract between builders and the look pipeline
what: The silent contract that decides how every mesh is styled and merged. Builders set mesh userData tags: matKind picks the cel ramp, outlineW the ink weight, part makes it a character part at 0.8x ink (CHAR_OUTLINE), noOutline skips the hull. Two tags live on the MATERIAL's userData instead: nature (with baseCol) marks environment materials that get the nature brightness gain, which toonify copies onto the new toon material and the static merge folds into its material key. Static-piece placement sets noMerge on a collider body to keep it out of the static merge. The pipeline sets its own: isOutline on every hull, _toon once a mesh is converted. A missing or misspelt tag fails silently: the mesh just gets the default ramp, the world ink weight, a hull it should not have, or the wrong brightness.
where: Set on meshes by builders: matKind shamble-core.js:687 (buildEntity, from the recipe's mat role) and :754 (_gunParts); outlineW :686, :716 (makeAMKRifle), :755; part :686, :716, :753, shamble-game.js:1200 ('jug'); noOutline :276 (applyVillain visor), :689 (copied from a recipe part's noOutline, e.g. :482), :716, :755, shamble-game.js:3237 (FXPool 'casing'); noMerge shamble-game.js:577, :583, :598. Set by the pipeline: isOutline :395 (addHull); _toon :384 (merged mesh), :415 (stylizeOne). Read: matKind :404, :415; outlineW and noOutline :405, :416; part :392 (CHAR_OUTLINE, :242 = 0.8); nature and baseCol :221 (applyEnv re-tint), :284 (toonify), :357-359 (_matSig merge key); noMerge :364; _toon :413; isOutline :271 (applyVillain), :364, :366, :386, :401, :413, :646 (applyFaction), shamble-game.js:245, :2573, :2575, shamble-editor.js:814, :877, :882.

Related bugs come from the stylize pass, not the tags themselves (CL8): PR #8, editor Ctrl+Z / Reset / Load left rebuilt pieces on plain materials with no ink (docs/reports/2026-10-14-editor-undo-ground.md:4, :13-14); in three-teams 3a a reviewer's fix as first written would have left the 7 bots parked at boot unstyled. Review caught it, and it was fixed in 5695e56 before it shipped (docs/reports/2026-10-16-three-teams-core-steps-1-6.md:88-91).
v2_note: Learn: per-mesh intent (material kind, ink weight, skip outline, environment-only brightening, keep out of merge) is real data the look needs. Avoid: carrying it as untyped, optional userData strings that a later sweep reads, with no check that a builder set them; a typo or missing tag shows only as a wrong look. In v2, if the look brief keeps any of these, they belong as typed fields on the builder's output (or the material key), set where the mesh is built. Ties CL4 (toonify reads matKind and nature), CL6 (addHull reads part), CL8 (stylize reads noOutline and outlineW, sets _toon) and CL9 (merge reads isOutline and noMerge).
reason: Look pipeline (styling inputs): redesign (look brief pending), with no further recommendation.
